long_biography.plain_text:
Oliver Steil built his career by moving between advice, investment and operating responsibility. After qualifying as an electrical engineer, he became a McKinsey partner focused on technology and telecommunications. He then led the mobile-service companies Debitel and Sunrise before joining Permira, where he created and headed the private-equity firm's portfolio group.

At TeamViewer, Steil shifted from advising portfolio companies to running one. He became chief executive and later chairman of the management board, guiding the remote-connectivity specialist as a listed enterprise-software company. His remit spans strategy, business development and commercial direction, while the company has expanded into digital workplace and industrial connectivity. The through-line is operational transformation: using an engineer's systems mindset, consulting discipline and investor experience to reposition established technology businesses rather than founding them.
